evidence.quote: Studielink is the official registration and application portal for programmes at Dutch higher education institutions.
Once you have found the right programme and checked the admission requirements, you can apply through Studielink.
If you are a non-EEA student, there are extra steps to complete your enrolment

entries.notes: Fontys English page 'Application and enrolment': step 1 is to apply through Studielink; the same page has the non-EEA steps (visa and residence permit, payment), so it covers applicants from abroad.

evidence.quote: Studielink is the official registration and application portal for programmes at Dutch higher education institutions.

Applicants, who possess internationally recognized diplomas and send them to us as soon as they have applied via Studielink, stand a greater chance to hear the result of their applications as early as possible.

entries.notes: Inholland FAQ for international applicants (inholland.nl/inhollandcom): applicants with internationally recognised diplomas have 'applied via Studielink'. The sentence says it in passing; the FAQ also has a 'I'm having problems with Studielink' entry that says to choose Inholland as the institution. The audit should open the page.

evidence.quote: Studielink is the official registration and application portal for programmes at Dutch higher education institutions.
Als je een studievisum nodig hebt, meld je je eerst aan via Studielink voor jouw opleiding.
Als je een buitenlands adres hebt kun jij je ook aanmelden via Studielink.

entries.notes: Hogeschool Rotterdam study-visa page (applicants who need a study visa apply via Studielink first, then use the school's application portal). The study-visa page says the visa procedure for its English-taught programmes differs; the Studielink step is stated for the programme enrolment.

evidence.quote: Studielink is the official registration and application portal for programmes at Dutch higher education institutions.
Woon je buiten de EER en kom je een voltijdstudie bij de HAN volgen? Dan moet je je eerder aanmelden omdat we een studievisum voor je moeten aanvragen.
Meld je uiterlijk 1 mei 2027 aan via Studielink als je bij de HAN wilt starten in september 2027.

entries.notes: HAN deadline page, section for full-time students from outside the EEA: they apply via Studielink.

evidence.quote: Studielink is the official registration and application portal for programmes at Dutch higher education institutions.
If you do not, or not yet, live in the Netherlands, you enrol via Studielink

entries.notes: International HU bachelor admissions page: applicants who do not live in the Netherlands enrol via Studielink after creating a username and password.

evidence.quote: Studielink is the official registration and application portal for programmes at Dutch higher education institutions.
Als je je aanmeldt met een niet-Nederlands diploma moet je rekening houden met toelatingstoetsen.
Na registratie in Studielink ontvang je instructies om in te loggen bij het EUR Aanmeldportaal.

entries.notes: EUR Bedrijfskunde admission page, paragraph for applicants with a non-Dutch diploma (the Moroccan Bac is one): register in Studielink, then log in to the EUR application portal. The page is not specific to non-EU nationality, it is specific to a foreign diploma.
